tagline: STIHL dealer for Whangamata. We sell, service, and advise
heroSubheading: Sales, servicing, and advice for outdoor power equipment you rely on.
aboutHtml:
We're STIHL SHOP Whangamata, the local dealer for outdoor power equipment. Phillip and Cheryl Clarke run the shop, and we've built our business on understanding what local crews, farmers, and landowners actually need for their work.

We stock a full range of STIHL equipment for everything from garden work to farm and commercial jobs. We back every sale with genuine service and support. Whether you're buying new or keeping equipment running, we're here to help. We service what we sell, stock genuine parts, and give straight advice on what will work best for your job and your budget.

Come see us at the shop. Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. We know your gear and we know Whangamata.
servicesIntro: We sell STIHL equipment and provide full servicing and parts support.
